name: What are common signs that my shower valve needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my shower valve needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common indicators that your shower valve requires repair include a sudden drop in water pressure, inconsistent water temperature (either too hot or too cold, or fluctuating rapidly), or a persistent drip from the showerhead even when the valve is fully closed. You might also notice a squealing or grinding noise when operating the shower, or difficulty turning the handle. Addressing these issues promptly can prevent further damage to your plumbing system and conserve water.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for low water pressure, inconsistent water temperature, a dripping showerhead, or unusual noises from the valve. These signs indicate a potential need for repair.
